findings.finding: Direct Nordic peer OEM International reported Q3 2026 (Jul-Sep) organic growth of +14% and order intake +40% to an all-time high, and Swedish manufacturing PMI rose to 58.1 in September with broad order growth — supporting the 'customers delayed investments' recovery case for Machinery & Equipment against a consensus that bakes in only ~1% organic.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026/27 (2026-07-16): organic +1% and weak Machinery & Equipment with EBITA in line (142 vs 143) -> stock -6.5% on the day (Finwire table). Organic growth is the line this stock trades on.
findings.original_quote: Index för leverantörernas rå- och insatsvarupriser ... / PMI: 'Inköpschefsindex (PMI) för svensk industri steg i september till 58,1 från 56,3 i augusti' — Swedbank 2026-10-01 (independence source); OEM: 'Net sales grew by 24% ... driven by organic growth of 14%'
findings.why_not_priced: SB1 (12 Oct) models only ~1% organic and Nordea (5 Oct) cut EBITA estimates on 'a more cautious view of growth'; consensus Q2 margin 11.7% is below last year's 11.8%. If the peer read-through were priced, estimates would have been moving up after OEM's 15 Oct print, not down; the stock is -4.4% over 60 days and ~30% off its highs per Handelsbanken. But it is a proxy: OEM is components distribution with Rest-of-Europe driving it, and B&B is more construction-exposed, so sized small.
findings.independence: Swedbank/Silf PMI September 2026, 58.1, order intake up broadly: https://www.swedbank.se/om-oss/press/newsroom.details.pmi-steg-till-58,1-i-september-%E2%80%93-bred-uppg%C3%A5ng-i-industrin.2BCB3241A4AFAF8B.html . Cutting the other way: Teqnion Q3 2026 organic -3% (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bd9db3ae69828d31be3a4880baa197b6a&lang=en&src=listed).

findings.finding: Input-cost pressure was rising through the quarter (PMI input-price index 77.6 in September, highest since June) and B&B itself flagged rising raw material, energy and shipping costs in Q1, a risk to the 50% gross margin the consensus margin assumes.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Gross margin has held at 50% for three quarters (Q1 report); Q1's 'less favourable business mix' in M&E coincided with the -6.5% day. No clean isolated margin-miss reaction on record.
findings.original_quote: "Index för leverantörernas rå- och insatsvarupriser steg i september till 77,6 från 75,7 i augusti ... Det höga och stigande kostnadstrycket är en tydlig motvind för industriföretagen." (Input-price index rose to 77.6 from 75.7 in September ... the high and rising cost pressure is a clear headwind for industrial companies.)
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus margin 11.7% vs 11.8% LY already shades it slightly; macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis and the company said in Q1 its decentralised units 'have been able to respond quickly and mitigate these effects', so sized small.
